verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KATONDA abeerenga naawe
Akuwenga omukisa,
Akubalire mu babe,
Akukuume-okutuusa-okufa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Katonda abeerenga naawe,
Akukwate mu ngalo ze,
Akuwe-emmere y'omwoyo,
Akukuume-okutuusa-okufa

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Katonda abeerenga naawe,
Entiisa bw'erikujjira,
Akwetoolooze ekisa,
Abeerenga naawe bulijjo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Katonda abeeranga naawe,
Akuwe okwagala kwe,
Akuyise mu mayengo,
Akutuuse mu kisulo kyo.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.
